_comment: Two enum additions audit-schema.json needs for engine v0.3. Both exist because the engine can now be honest about not knowing, which the original six states had no way to express.

patches.reason: The description does not identify a user, a workflow and an outcome, so there is nothing to audit. Without this state the engine must pick some other verdict for an unauditable input, which is how v0.1 returned USE_SIMPLER_APPROACH with a full roadmap for an empty string.

The audit is genuinely undecided and a named question would settle it. Used only during the clarification loop; the final audit always commits to one of the framework's six states. This is what lets the MCQ layer show its working instead of picking a verdict and hiding the doubt.
